title: Not very wide, looks a little small too…
text:
Not very wide, looks a little small too…. [[VIDEOID:280800881c23ca12345583a369371cc4]] This is a unique inflatable with a bat! For some reason though I was a little underwhelmed. The size just doesn’t seem that big. Yes, it is 5 feet tall, but not very wide. I think the purple stone could have been like a gray stone color for a tomb stone. The wings were just more flimsy than what I was expecting. It nice though, if you need a bat.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
